Real data hides duplicates and nulls.

sections.vo: Schema changes are the riskiest deploys. You can't see what a migration breaks. Real data hides duplicates and nulls. Code breaks quietly. You find out in production.

card.title: Blueprint
card.sub: See the impact. Rehearse on real data. Ship a pull request that works.

sections.vo: Blueprint lets you see the impact, rehearse on a copy of your real data, and ship a pull request that works.

vo.dashboard-1: It works on real repos, with Drizzle, Prisma, supabase-js, or plain SQL migrations.

vo.import-1: Import a repo. Here, the bundled demo app, Tallyhub.
import-2: Blueprint reads eight tables, the sample rows, and thirty-five queries.

vo.map-1: The map shows every table with its row count, and which code modules read or write it.

vo.inspect-1: Click a table for its columns, planned changes, and queries.
vo.inspect-2: The data tab shows its real rows.

vo.module-1: Click a module to see its queries, line by line.

vo.ask-1: Ask the agent for a change in plain English.
vo.ask-2: It proposes ghost tables and columns, each with a reason, and buttons to accept, reject, lock, or edit it.

vo.draw-1: Or draw it. Drag projects to orgs.
vo.draw-2: Blueprint proposes the column, the backfill, and the foreign key, and counts the rows it can fill.

vo.drawtable-2: and the agent fills in its columns.

vo.rule-1: Forbid an import between modules, and the violation is flagged for the agent to fix.

vo.steer-1: Reject and lock what you don't want.

vo.impact-1: Code impact lists every affected query, with file and line.

sections.label: Rehearse on a copy of the data

vo.rehearse-1: Rehearse runs the real migration on a copy of your data, and shows every changed row.
vo.conflicts-1: It catches what would fail in production: twenty-two invoices with no org.
vo.conflicts-2: Pick a fix, and the rehearsal passes.

vo.sql-1: The migration is generated: columns, backfills, then constraints, in one transaction.

vo.tests-1: Your repo's own tests and typecheck run against the migrated data.
vo.tests-2: Three fail, so the agent fixes the code.
vo.tests-3: All eighteen pass, and every file is labeled: generated, or agent fix.
vo.pr-1: One click opens the pull request.

card.title: Every button is an agent action.
items: Fix code, run tests, open the PR.

sections.vo: Every button in Blueprint is an action the agent can call too. You and the agent work on one plan.
